messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "long term use may increase risk of broken bone"
set: ["long term use may increase risk of broken bone", "use more than once per day may increase risk of broken bone", "long term use requires maintenance dose", "lowest dose that works is used long term", "avoid activities that increase risk of bleeding or injury", "skipping doses can increase risk of infection resistant to medication", "tell doctor about history of long QT syndrome", "individual risk of cardiovascular events", "minimize risk of sleep disturbances", "maintenance dose may need to increase after surgery", "maintenance dose may need to increase during infection", "maintenance dose may need to increase during fever", "avoid broken or irritated skin", "may increase dose after several weeks if there is lack of clinical improvement", "doctor may increase dose after several weeks if needed", "maintenance dose may need to increase during condition flare"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
